Sam wrote about the day in the diary. The weather was cloudy that day. Sam borrowed a book about science from the museum. They advertise the new phone on TV.
David is interested in cooking. Last Wednesday, Sam and David went to the corner store. The corner store is one of the best places in the city. The self-checkout asked for ID.
Both of them like bread and coffee. Sam wants to be a doctor in the future. Life is full of small surprises.
